title: Daily Schedule
text: Login Tracker Login rewards reset each day and are claimed only once per account. The player has the entire month to claim the full 25 login awards. Logins do not have to be consecutive. There are bonus rewards for 7, 14, and 21 logins. Merit Quests Merit Quests reset daily and complete automatically (They do not need to be turned in) They reset each day. There are bonus rewards for completing 3, 5, and 7 of the quests. Some of the quests require the player be a minimum level and/or a one time unlock fee in order to gain access. Details Current Events (WIP) Events Recurring Events Schedule. Details about each event can be found in this Wiki
